mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ai_task_step (run_id, step_no, stage_id, tool_name, side_effect, args_json, purpose, status) VALUES
(#{step.runId}, #{step.stepNo}, #{step.stageId}, #{step.toolName}, #{step.sideEffect}, #{step.argsJson}, #{step.purpose}, #{step.status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, step_no, stage_id, tool_name, side_effect, args_json, purpose, status, result_summary, result_json, evidence_json, error_code, error_message, cost_ms, attempts, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_task_step WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY step_no
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task_step SET status = 'PENDING', error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, finished_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'SKIPPED'
UPDATE ai_task_step SET status = 'CANCELLED', finished_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
